technical.title: Evaluating and mitigating trajectory prediction noise in autonomous vehicles
technical.summary: This paper evaluates how sensing and localization uncertainties affect transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models in real-world autonomous vehicle deployments.
technical.why: It addresses a critical reality gap between curated datasets and noisy real-world perception for autonomous driving safety.

technical.title: PhysPPF learns robotic manipulation using multi-scale physical representations
technical.summary: PhysPPF is a vision-language-action framework that bridges past, present, and future physical representations to handle complex robotic manipulation tasks requiring precise 3D contact and long-horizon coordination.
technical.why: It advances vision-language-action models by embedding explicit 3D contact cues and temporal dynamics into robotic control.

technical.title: ProMo-CoOp uses probabilistic modes and constrained optimization for trajectory prediction
technical.summary: ProMo-CoOp is a two-stage data-driven framework that clusters agent trajectories into behavioral modes using a Gaussian Mixture Model and solves convex optimization problems for multimodal prediction.
technical.why: It improves multimodal intent prediction and trajectory generation for safe autonomous vehicle navigation.

technical.title: Clinical3D-Bench evaluates spatial reasoning of multimodal LLMs in hospitals
technical.summary: Clinical3D-Bench is a simulated benchmark featuring 3,368 questions across 373 hospital-room layouts to test the spatial intelligence of multimodal LLMs in clinical environments.
technical.why: It provides a rigorous way to evaluate 3D spatial understanding and reasoning for vision-language models in complex environments.

technical.title: NightWatch adds continuous perception to vision-language computer-use agents
technical.summary: NightWatch is a plug-and-play framework designed to overcome the perception-action gap in computer-use agents by providing continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the underlying agent.
technical.why: It directly addresses latency and staleness issues for vision-language models operating in dynamic interfaces.

technical.title: UbiEnlight delivers real-time low-light video enhancement on mobile devices
technical.summary: UbiEnlight is the first diffusion-transformer-based on-device system for real-time, temporally stable low-light video enhancement, tackling spatiotemporally coupled motion and illumination degradations.
technical.why: It presents advanced on-device video processing techniques relevant to mobile computer vision and wearable applications.

technical.title: LoKiTO combines Chebyshev polynomials with neural ESDFs for UAV planning
technical.summary: LoKiTO is a 3D local kinodynamic trajectory optimizer for aerial robotics that integrates Chebyshev parameterization with an online neural Euclidean Signed Distance Field representation.
technical.why: It offers a memory-efficient local planning solution leveraging continuous neural maps for real-time robotic navigation.

technical.title: PhoneQC benchmarks multimodal LLMs for remote smartphone trade-in inspection
technical.summary: PhoneQC examines the limitations of using vision-language models for order-level smartphone trade-in appraisals, highlighting obstacles such as single-view defect sets and human staff form requirements.
technical.why: It highlights current accuracy and workflow hurdles when deploying multimodal models for automated visual inspection tasks.

technical.title: CUA-SEE provides a closed-loop evaluation environment for computer-use agents
technical.summary: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers to improve the diagnostic and discriminative value of computer-use agent benchmarks.
technical.why: It helps researchers dynamically scale and target capability probes for vision-language agent evaluations.

technical.title: OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo open-source Linux runtime for agents
technical.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux that allows AI agents to write signed shields blocking exploit paths on running systems.
technical.why: It showcases practical runtime defense integrations where AI agents actively protect infrastructure.

business.title: Agentic AI tasks generate 450% more enterprise network traffic
business.summary: Enterprise networks are facing severe strain as companies deploy AI. Tasks conducted by AI agents generate an estimated 450% more network traffic than identical tasks executed by human workers.
business.why: It identifies specific enterprise infrastructure bottlenecks caused by shifting to autonomous AI agents.

business.title: Amazon acquires Decart for $7.5 billion to improve Trainium chips
business.summary: Amazon has agreed to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion. The deal is part of Amazon's broader efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips and narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia.
business.why: It highlights major hardware investments aimed at competing with Nvidia's market dominance.

business.title: Dell earnings beat expectations on AI server demand and buyback
business.summary: Dell's overall sales more than doubled on an annual basis during the third quarter, driven heavily by AI server demand. The company also authorized a $25 billion buyback.
business.why: It reflects the concrete financial returns hardware manufacturers are seeing from enterprise AI adoption.

business.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, threatening startup valuations
business.summary: Anthropic shares have fallen below their IPO price. This post-IPO slump could put downward pressure on AI startup valuations across the industry.
business.why: It signals potential shifts in market confidence and valuation metrics for AI startups.

business.title: Crusoe investor bets on solar and batteries for data centers
business.summary: Next-generation data centers will require tens of gigawatts of power annually. One of Crusoe's investors believes solar power and energy storage are the obvious solutions to meet this surging demand.
business.why: It addresses the critical infrastructure and energy constraints facing large-scale AI deployment.

business.title: Colette Kress returns to Nvidia CFO role after leadership changes
business.summary: Colette Kress is back as Nvidia's CFO after leading the company for 11 days during Jensen Huang's sudden departure, following her work steering Nvidia through billions in AI financing deals.
business.why: It offers insight into the financial leadership guiding Nvidia's massive AI capital deployment.

business.title: Crunchbase estimates unicorn board valuation is closer to $11 trillion
business.summary: The more than 1,900 startups on the Crunchbase Unicorn Board have a combined valuation of roughly $9 trillion based on last reported funding, but a new model puts the current figure closer to $11 trillion.
business.why: It provides macroeconomic data on private market valuations in the tech sector.

business.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang returns following executive investigations
business.summary: After a sudden departure following acknowledged affairs and internal investigations, Nvidia CEO, president, and co-founder Jensen Huang has returned to lead the company.
business.why: It details executive leadership stability at the most critical hardware provider in the AI industry.

business.title: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO and stock recovers
business.summary: Jensen Huang has returned to his role as CEO of Nvidia, coinciding with a positive market response and climbing stock numbers.
business.why: It tracks direct market valuation correlations to key executive presence at Nvidia.

business.title: AWS survey shows growing AI adoption and returns across Asia
business.summary: Businesses across the Asia-Pacific region are seeing positive returns from their AI investments, according to an AWS survey, even though confidence in precisely measuring those gains varies.
business.why: It measures regional economic impact and adoption trends in international markets.

models.title: Apple releases Depth Pro 2 for sharp monocular depth estimation
models.summary: Depth Pro 2 estimates metric depth for every pixel from single photos, videos, or live feeds at full resolution. It features sharp edges, temporal consistency, and includes an integrated focal length estimator.
models.why: It is a vital computer vision model for high-resolution metric depth estimation and 3D reconstruction tasks.

models.title: Harness Hub releases Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted LoRA for coding agents
models.summary: A new LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B was trained via reinforcement learning for software engineering and terminal tasks. It matches maximum-effort thinking performance while generating about 4.5x fewer tokens per task.
models.why: It drastically cuts token generation costs for LLM-powered coding and terminal agents.

models.title: Tencent introduces Hy4 flash cost-effective multimodal language model
models.summary: Hy4 flash is Tencent's cost-effective model featuring 220B total parameters with 12B active parameters per token. It natively accepts text and image inputs and supports various deployment and inference frameworks.
models.why: It introduces a massive sparse mixture-of-agents style architecture optimized for high-throughput multimodal tasks.

models.title: Apple releases FastFrames for video generation at interactive latency
models.summary: Apple released FastFrames-S and FastFrames-L, autoregressive two-step video diffusion models generating 480p video at interactive latency. An optimized version of LingBot 1.3B is also included for fluid camera control.
models.why: It advances real-time generative video workflows with interactive latency.

models.title: Thinkingmachines releases Inkling 2 Mini general-purpose multimodal model
models.summary: Inkling 2 Mini is a new general-purpose multimodal model accepting text and image inputs and generating text. It supports multiple coding languages and is designed for developers building agentic systems, tool-use systems, coding assistants, and chatbots.
models.why: It offers an open-weight multimodal option for building developer applications and agentic workflows.

models.title: Higurashi-ai releases Haru-4B full-duplex spoken dialogue model
models.summary: Haru-4B is a low-latency, multilingual full-duplex continuous spoken dialogue foundation model that listens and speaks simultaneously at 7.5 Hz using a 64-dimensional latent per frame.
models.why: It introduces native full-duplex conversational audio processing without waiting states.
